BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to special permits for poultry slaughter,preparation, and sale; and amending RCW 69.07.103.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 69.07.103 and 2003 c 397 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

Such activities shall not be conducted without thepermit. However, if the)).
